# Landing page brief (Tier 1 account page or Tier 2 cluster page)

Built by the CRO and landing pages service (17). ABM gives this brief.

- Page type: account / cluster · URL: `/for/{{account_slug}}` (Tier 1 pages use noindex)
- Locale: {{locale}} (right-to-left for Arabic)
- Hero: "{{value_point}} for {{account_name_or_cluster}}" · subline from the account's own priority (cited in the brief)
- Section 1: the problem in their words (from the brief)
- Section 2: how the client solves it (approved value points only)
- Section 3: proof (approved case studies from the same industry or market)
- Section 4: the people behind it (account owner photo and calendar link)
- CTA: book a meeting with {{account_lead}} · secondary: download {{asset}}
- Tracking: UTM `utm_source=abm&utm_medium={{channel}}&utm_campaign={{play_id}}&utm_content={{account_id}}`; form maps to the account in the CRM
- Consent: cookie banner and privacy notice for the market; EU Article 14 link
- Do not show the account logo unless the account approved it.
